questions.stem: Which energy transfer pathway involves a force causing movement?
questions.explanation: Mechanical work is the energy transfer pathway that occurs when a force causes an object to move. Examples include lifting a weight or pushing a box along the floor.

questions.stem: How many main energy transfer pathways are there?
questions.explanation: There are four main energy transfer pathways: mechanical work, electrical work, heating, and radiation. These describe how energy moves between stores.
